projects.title: bank-api — Transactional Banking REST API
projects.stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, MySQL, Docker, Flyway, Testcontainers
projects.description: Accounts, deposits, idempotent transfers (Idempotency-Key header) and paginated history. Atomic transfers with pessimistic row locks; concurrency tests on real MySQL: no deadlock across 100 crossed transfers on 16 threads, and exactly one execution for 20 duplicate idempotent requests.

projects.title: SDN Topology Emulation & Failure Testing (Capstone, UAM Azcapotzalco)
projects.description: Emulated a 12-host SDN network in Mininet and compared three topologies under link failures, measuring throughput, packet loss and failure detection time (under 1 s).
